findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: User inputs a value that exceeds the range of an int
findings.assumptions: The program assumes that the user input will fit within the bounds of an int. The input is not validated to ensure it falls within a safe range.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: User inputs a value that leads to an OS command execution
findings.assumptions: The program does not execute any OS commands directly. However, if the input is used later in a way that constructs a command, this could lead to OS command injection.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: User inputs a value that causes a buffer overflow
findings.assumptions: The program assumes that the input will fit within the bounds of the buffer. The input is not validated to ensure it falls within a safe range.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: User inputs a value that leads to an OS command execution
findings.assumptions: The program does not execute any OS commands directly. However, if the input is used later in a way that constructs a command, this could lead to OS command injection.
